name: Enger (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Enger (blue linden leaves on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Enger; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Enger arms — blue linden leaves on yellow
